headerDisplay: Waste collection calendar from Aprica Spa. Shows countdown days until next collection for each waste type.

geociv.title: Geo-Civic ID (geociv)
geociv.description: Your address geo-civic ID. Visit https://www.apricaspa.it/it/bergamo/servizi/raccolta-differenziata, enter your address, and find the geociv value in the network request payload.

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (minutes)
pollInterval.description: How often to check the waste collection calendar, in minutes. Default: 360 (6 hours).

timezone.title: Timezone (IANA)
timezone.description: IANA timezone of your collection area. Aprica collection dates are at midnight local time, so this keeps 'today/tomorrow' correct. Default: Europe/Rome.
